children.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list.

direction.description: The direction in which the list items are laid out. Values: `vertical` stacks items from top to bottom; `horizontal` lays items out from left to right.

align.description: Defines the alignment of list items along the cross axis. Values: `start` aligns items to the cross-axis start edge; `center` centers items on the cross axis; `end` aligns items to the cross-axis end edge.
